summary: Install and use the RunAPI CLI for one-off artifacts and results from registered CLI-backed services. Use when the user asks an agent to inspect installed commands, run a supported service, pass JSON request bodies, wait for tasks, or automate a supported RunAPI workflow from the terminal. Use an SDK for app or production integration.
